versions.changelog:
Initial release of metric-definition-catalog skill.

- Consolidates dispersed metric definitions, formulas, responsibilities, exceptions, and common misuses into a unified catalog.
- Designed for analytics workflows; not a replacement for BI platform configuration or metric source creation.
- Produces structured outputs: metric directory, definition, calculation, non-applicable scenarios, common misuses, and maintenance suggestions.
- Emphasizes information completeness, review drafts, explicit boundaries, and safe read-only operations.
- Supports both script-based and direct template-based outputs depending on environment capabilities.
